none: PAS LIN-7F1743: Roman copper alloy radiate
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy radiate of Carausius (286-93), Possibly SALVS AVG, probably 'C' mint, RIC V, Pt II, p. 491, cf. no. 396. The type initially looks like PAX but there appears to be the legend ...VS AVG and there might be an altar to the left of the figure. (Coin has been included in Sam Moorhead's corpus for RIC)
